Blend / Stealth Check (DEX)
Faceless: +1 synergy from sneak ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. 1 Free Action. Passive. Armor Check Penalty, Disposition, Flat-Footed. Rules p.118.

Falsify / Cover Up Check (WIS)
Traceless: +1 synergy from blend ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Required gear: Cleaner Kit; available. 1 Minute. Secret. Concentration, Gear (Cleaner Kit), Vision. Rules p.129.

Falsify / Disguise Check (WIS)
Traceless: +1 synergy from blend ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Required gear: Disguise Kit; available. Time Varies (Take 10/Take 20). Secret. Cross-Check, Gear (Disguise Kit), Hands-On, Vision. Rules p.129.

Falsify / Forgery Check (INT)
Traceless: +1 synergy from blend ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Required gear: Forgery Kit; available. Time Varies. Secret. Concentration, Cross-Check, Gear (Forgery Kit), Hands-On, Vision. Rules p.130.

Bluff / Deception Check (CHA)
Silver Tongue: +1 synergy from manipulate ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. 1 Full Action (Take 10/Take 20). Secret. Bribe, Crowd, Disposition, Language. Rules p.120.

Impress / Influence Check (CHA)
Silver Tongue: +1 synergy from manipulate ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Time Varies (Take 10/Take 20). Secret. Bribe, Disposition, Language, Remote. Rules p.132.

Impress / Performance Check (CHA)
Silver Tongue: +1 synergy from manipulate ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Time Varies. Secret. Bribe, Concentration, Crowd, Disposition, Language, Remote. Rules p.132.

Impress / Persuasion Check (CHA)
Silver Tongue: +1 synergy from manipulate ranks; normal synergy stacking applies. Time Varies (Take 10/Take 20). Active. Bribe, Crowd, Disposition, Language, Remote. Rules p.133.

notes: Silver Tongue: no shared language reduces the Impress/Persuasion result cap by5instead of20(p.205).

system.description:
Core Ability — Dexterous: when you spend an action die on a Dexterity-based skill check, roll it twice and add both.

Skill points: 8 + Int modifier per level (×4 at Career Level 1). Vitality: 8 + Con modifier per level.

coreAbility.name: Dexterous
coreAbility.description: when you spend an action die on a Dexterity-based skill check, roll it twice and add both.

options.name: Booby Trap
options.description: Sabotage devices and set traps in half the time.

options.name: Improvisation
options.description: As a full action, improvise one common item from whatever is at hand.

options.name: Master Thief
options.description: Once per session, set an opposed skill result 1 higher than your opponent's.

options.name: Procure
options.description: Hold extra Reserve picks and improve your Requests through back channels.

options.name: Skill Mastery
options.description: Choose a class skill: –2 error range and taking 10 takes normal time.

options.name: Stash It
options.description: Hidden objects on you are only found on a threat or critical success.

options.name: Tricky
options.description: Once per round, when an adjacent opponent misses you by 5 or more, immediately take a free Tire action against that opponent; you may substitute Acrobatics (Dex) for Resolve (Con).
